title: CRLF input bytes are rewritten despite a successful role dispatch
detail: Material: FO passes valid UTF-8 checklist and scope-note files with CRLF line endings through --role. read_text() normalizes both to LF; exit 0 and the committed record no longer contains the supplied bytes. value-ac[AC-1] requires both input files' bytes. Reproduced by acceptance.sh step 4 and probes.json; both preservation checks are false. Existing test reads expected inputs with read_text() too, masking this case.
fix: Preserve source newline bytes through record creation, retry comparison and stdout, and compare raw bytes in the role regression test.
